version.changelog: Add the ClawHub skill card for registry verification.

llm.summary: This skill documents read-only queries to a paid public Google Play data API and clearly discloses its network and API-key requirements.

dimensions.detail: The skill requires network access to api.replynodes.com and a ReplyNodes API key or x402-capable client, which is proportionate to its third-party paid API purpose and is disclosed.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact contains markdown documentation only; no executable scripts, installer hooks, or package-time behavior were present.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions constrain use to specific GET routes, require checking capabilities and pricing before batches, and explicitly prohibit Google credentials, account access, publishing, write operations, and catalog enumeration.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No persistence, background workers, privilege escalation, local indexing, or credential-store access is requested; the API key is directed to remain in an environment variable and out of logs.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is to retrieve public Android app data as normalized JSON, and the documented capabilities are limited to read-only Google Play data lookups.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Before installing, understand that use of this skill sends public Google Play lookup requests to ReplyNodes and may incur metered charges. Keep the ReplyNodes API key in an environment variable, confirm capabilities and pricing before batches, and avoid sending Google account credentials or session data.
